notFound: Claude Code was not found on this computer.
notFoundFix: Install it (claude.com/claude-code), then ask Claude there to start the silent mode again.
signIn: Claude Code is not signed in.
signInFix: In a terminal, type `claude auth login`, then ask again.
keyFix: In Claude Code, type /wow-mcp:setup: it gives the command to change it.
credit: your API account has no credit left.
creditFix: Add some in Anthropic's Console, then ask again.
limitFix: Ask again once it is back to zero (settings, Usage), or with a lighter model.
lateFix: Ask again, maybe with a shorter question or less effort.
otherFix: Ask again; if it goes on, see the Help tab of the settings.
slotNotes: Holds one of Claude's answers on its way into the game. Keep it enabled.
